title: check-governed-merges: measure whether a governed-surface PR landing via a merge-queue batch is visible to the audit (#11831 ruling)
body:
Chartered in #11831's ruling (maintainer, 2026-08-25, verbatim 「10150 是我合并的，其他接受」; full record = #11831 comment 5404974747). Filed by PM session `session_01KWRU3s15AJz7PGW7a7wdCh` per the confirmed checklist. The #10150 instance itself was confirmed a maintainer hand-merge (no violation) — this card is the **structural** question that outlives it.

**Content**: establish by measurement whether `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` (129 assertions green today) would flag a governed-surface PR (`docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`) that reached `main` **through a merge-queue batch**. Construct or replay the queue-batch signature (batch merge-commit shape, parent/child pairing, `merged_at` collapse, `merged_by` semantics) against the gate — measure, ⛔ do not reason from the gate's source alone.

**Disposition rule**:
- Gate **sees** it → post the discriminating evidence on this card and close; the post-hoc-audit model (2026-08-18 ruling) is confirmed to cover the queue route.
- Gate is **blind** → add the recognition so a governed-surface queue landing appears in the audit list. That is audit **tightening** (a Bug fix); ⛔ never weaken or bypass anything to get there. The fix rides this card.

**Lane note for triage**: per the lane table, a gate whose SUBJECT is the governed surface itself (`check-governed-merges` is named there) anchors to `domain:skills` — triage confirms the lane.

**Acceptance criterion**: a written verdict either way, backed by the constructed-signature run; recognition added iff blind, with a pin so the signature stays covered.
